629:t_022:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The $$ダブルオーライザー$$ is drifting with its systems still offline!」

629:t_022:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Send out a recovery team!」

629:t_022:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'll leave... the rest to you...」

629:t_023:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Damn it! How dare you do that to $$刹那$$ and $$ティエリア$$!」

629:t_023:3.en:
$$シン$$
「$$刹那$$ tried to talk to you! And yet...!」

629:t_023:6.en:
$$スザク$$
「If we pull back here, the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ will reach Earth...!」

629:t_023:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「But we cannot continue fighting any longer...」

629:t_023:8.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! A massive gravity quake has been detected in a sector further behind our position!」

629:t_023:9.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Judging by conditions in the area, we believe the main $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ force has arrived!」

629:t_023:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So the full-scale invasion is finally beginning...」

629:t_023:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We also need to deal with that. All units, fall back to the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ for now.」

629:t_023:12.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「This is an order from your commander! I will not accept any refusal!」

629:t_023:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Do we... have no choice but to retreat...?」

629:t_024:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「What you opened wasn't $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

629:t_024:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It was what you'd call Pandora's box. That's why despair came pouring out.」

629:t_024:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But at its bottom lies hope...」

629:t_025:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Even if I shoot them down one after another, it doesn't feel like it'll ever end!」

629:t_025:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Keep it up, Darling! We've just gotta do it!」

629:t_025:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But if we keep fighting like this, we'll hit our limit eventually...」

629:t_100:0.en:
$$刹那$$
(This sensation I feel from the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...)

629:t_100:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$刹那$$... I know what you're thinking.」

629:t_100:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Don't let common sense or preconceptions constrain you. You should act on what you feel.」

629:t_100:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That is your duty, and supporting you is mine.」

629:t_100:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「First, I'll make contact with as many $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ as possible! Here I go!」

629:t_101:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
(This chaotic sensation... Can I call it a will...?)

629:t_102:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(What do they want...? This sensation... seems a little different from hostility...)

629:t_102:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(What should we do...!? Is there nothing we can do besides fight...!?)

629:t_103:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Every time I make contact with them, I receive feedback from the $$サイコ・フレーム$$...)

629:t_103:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
(The $$ユニコーン$$ is trying to tell me something... Is it... the will of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...?)

629:t_104:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Is it because my senses have grown sharper!? I can feel something from the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$!」

629:t_105:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Hostile organisms are approaching.」

629:t_105:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Unable to answer. ...I am not under the $$人類銀河同盟$$'s control.」

629:t_105:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Therefore, identifying the targets as friend or foe is left to Ensign $$レド$$'s organization... In other words, to Ensign $$レド$$ himself.」

629:t_105:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Relevant recommendation: the danger posed by the targets' presence is real. I recommend prioritizing your own safety.」

629:t_105:7.en:
$$レド$$
「So in the end... I have no choice but to fight...?」

629:t_106:0.en:
$$レド$$
「I am setting a new operational objective. This unit will analyze the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$' true nature and goals as thoroughly as possible to inform future strategy.」

629:t_106:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. I recommend supporting $$刹那$$'s unit, which plays an extremely important role in understanding the targets.」

629:t_106:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Got it! As long as he doesn't give up, we'll keep supporting him!」

629:t_107:0.en:
$$アルト$$
($$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$... If you believe in your song, I'll believe in you.)

629:t_107:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(You two will definitely pull it off...! So I'll protect you!)

629:t_108:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$アイモ$$... It's a lovely song.」

629:t_108:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Did you know? $$アイモ$$ is a love song.」

629:t_108:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Come on, let's do our best! We need to protect this song too!」
